news_intelligence.title: BHEL Q2FY27 results: Net profit jumps over two-fold to ₹821 crore
news_intelligence.summary:
State-owned BHEL on Wednesday reported a two-fold jump in consolidated net profit to Rs 820.94 crore for the September quarter, driven by higher income from key business verticals such as power and industry. BHEL is India's largest engineering and manufacturing enterprise in the energy and infrastructure sector. The company had clocked a net profit of Rs 374.89 crore in the second quarter of the preceding financial year, BHEL said in an exchange filing. In July-September, the company's total income rose 24 per cent to Rs 9,553.01 crore from Rs 7,686.11 crore in the year-ago period. Sharing segment-wise break-up, the company said that from power and industry businesses, it earned revenue of Rs 6,637.90 crore and Rs 2,662.45 crore, respectively, up from Rs 5,675.64 crore and 1,836.16 crore garnered from the two verticals in the September quarter of FY25. Expenses stood at Rs 8,482.40 crore compared to Rs 7,201.54 crore a year ago.
